title: Tamagoyaki with edamame and rice
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 110 ml water for 12 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with soy sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.
Oil a pan thinly, pour in a thin layer of egg, let it set slightly and roll it up; push the roll aside and repeat layer by layer.
Boil the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes.
Slice the omelette roll and serve with the edamame and rice.
